title: RE harness run report (v1)
description: One JSON document per run, archived under docs/re/harness-runs/. Small and deterministic: no timestamps, no absolute paths, keys sorted. Gate reports (self-parity, xyflow-examples, selftest) carry oracle=real with the oracle library versions read from their package.json. covered is reserved for green candidate-against-reference verdicts; self-parity verdicts never count as covered (SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY §8.1). At L0 the candidate side is unsupported (candidate).

oracle.description: real = produced by the pinned library itself.

oracleVersions.description: Versions read from the oracle packages' own package.json files.

candidate.description: Candidate status per library. At L0: unsupported, with the lot that delivers the DiagramState path.

causeKind.description: Why a scenario is unknown. Only fixture-extraction is acceptable in an archived gate report.
